svg.title: Voice to Vision
svg.desc: Animated illustration: a waveform listens, three spoken phrases appear, and a picture of a cabin in the snow resolves from noise, turns to night and gains a deer.
svg.text: Say “a cabin in the snow … at night … add a deer on
the left” and the picture updates while you are still
talking. Code owns the scene; an LLM director only
picks among the options the code offers. A sibling
tool builds UI prototypes by voice.
illustration of the live loop · undo is instant
speech → Whisper → LLM director → image model
